left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  ≥1 Primary Anterior Teeth with early carious lesion  [AND] (Class V) of ICDAS scores 1-2

right.raw_text: -  Subjects whose parents are willing and able to maintain good oral hygiene for their children  [AND] and attend study visits

left.raw_text: -  Subjects with Saliva  [AND] of normal flow rates (30-60sec) and with healthy saliva pH 6
-  Subjects with a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 12 primary anterior teeth with early carious lesions  [AND] Class V of ICDAS score 1-2

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Primary anterior teeth in which carious lesions  [AND] are scored with ICDAS ≥3

left.raw_text: -  Subjects on medication that affects the salivary flow rate
-  Subjects with evidence of reduced salivary flow  [OR] (>60 sec) or with acidic saliva pH˂5
